item.title: GhostCue 2.0.0
item.description:
• Introducing the Live Rail! GhostCue now listens to your conversation and suggests the right section the moment its topic comes up — click a suggestion to jump straight to that card
  • The rail hears both sides of the call and runs entirely on your Mac — nothing is recorded, nothing ever leaves your device
  • Suggestions appear as frosted gold cards beside your cue deck, newest first, and quietly fade away when the moment passes — drag the rail anywhere you like
  • Arm it with the wand button on the cue card — first use downloads the on-device speech model and asks for Microphone and Screen Recording access (Apple Silicon)
  • Cue cards are now locked while you present — double-click the text or use the new pencil button to edit, so a stray click can never mangle your script mid-call
  • New shortcuts: ⌘[ and ⌘] switch cue cards even while you're working in another app, and ⌘' hide/unhide now works in Cue Mode
  • Completely reworked Bluetooth headphone support — no more mic connect/disconnect loops, and headset mics now use the modern high-quality audio link
